technology_name: A SYNTHESIS OF NON-EDIBLE OIL BASED MAGNETORHEOLOGICAL FLUID WITH ENHANCED LUBRICITY
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Smart Material Synthesis / Industrial Lubricant Compound
problem_solved: Standard magnetorheological damping fluids based on synthetic oils exhibit high particle friction wear, rapid settling issues, and limited thermal stability across severe shear stresses.
description: The formulation of a green, high-lubricity magnetorheological (MR) fluid composite utilizing a non-edible organic seed oil base, tailored magnetic iron particles, and structural shear-thinning additives to optimize fluid-to-solid transitions under localized magnetic excitation fields.
applications: Variable vehicle shock absorbers, industrial automated vibration dampers, smart prosthetic knee control elements, and heavy seismic structural isolation setups.
